statement: The kept NuGet.config is only worth what its guard rejects. Each case was applied, measured against tools/ci/policy_validator.py and the file restored and compared byte for byte. The validator writes its findings to stderr, which an earlier reading of stdout alone missed; the exit code was the reliable signal and both streams are read here.

cases.finding: FAIL ci-policy restore-sources: packageSources does not clear the inherited sources
FAIL ci-policy restore-sources: packageSources declares 2 sources; exactly one is allowed
FAIL ci-policy restore-sources: no packageSourceMapping, so central package management cannot decide which source a package comes from
FAIL ci-policy restore-sources: NuGet.config declares 0 disabledPackageSources sections; exactly one is required so a host entry cannot disable the only source
